_GC_BATCH_MIN_REQUESTS = 64


async def _gather_with_gc_pause(*awaitables: Any) -> list[Any]:
    """asyncio.gather with the GC paused for large batches.

    Parsed payloads allocate millions of small objects per large batch; gen2
    collections mid-batch pause the event loop and amplify GIL contention
    with the worker threads. GC resumes automatically after the batch.
    """
    tune = len(awaitables) >= _GC_BATCH_MIN_REQUESTS and gc.isenabled()
    if tune:
        gc.disable()
    try:
        return await asyncio.gather(*awaitables, return_exceptions=True)
    finally:
        if tune:
            gc.enable()
